requirements.requirement: Case (a) closed: after a jump to a branch whose newest reply is B, a model with no ratio borrows the live pair measured in this run
requirements.evidence: Run in a mktemp clone at 6216ef9 after `npm ci` (removed afterwards). A scratch test on the real `seedTable`, `withLiveSample`, `reseedTable` and `ratioFor` uses this session's measured ratios: A = Opus live at 1.677, B = Gemini seed 1.239, C = Fable with no entry. After `reseedTable(live, [B 1.239])`, `latest` is Opus and C reads `{ k: 1.677, uncalibrated: true }` (B keeps its own 1.239). Against Fable's true prompt (875,338 for an estimate of 528,004) that is 1.16% off, down from 25.3% when it borrowed Gemini's seed at 9ded10d.

requirements.requirement: Case (b) closed: a second jump, to a branch with no reply, still borrows the live pair rather than reading k 1
requirements.evidence: In the same scratch test, `reseedTable(jumped, [])` leaves `latest` on Opus. C reads `{ k: 1.677, uncalibrated: true }` and A reads `{ k: 1.677, uncalibrated: false }`. At 9ded10d, C read k 1 (39.7% low) while A was live.

requirements.requirement: Task 4.5 code: `reseedTable` keeps `latest` while its entry is live, otherwise takes `seeds[0]?.pair`, with no `?? table.latest`
requirements.evidence: `git show 6216ef9 -- src/domain/calibration.ts`: `const keepsLatest = table.latest !== undefined && table.entries.get(pairKey(table.latest))?.live === true; return { entries, latest: keepsLatest ? table.latest : seeds[0]?.pair };`. This is the remedy run in michael-validate-3.json, character for character. A one-line why-comment and an updated JSDoc came with it, and nothing else in `src` changed.

tests/domain/calibration.test.ts:
- :112 is now *a tree jump keeps a live borrow source, and before any live sample takes the new branch's newest seed*: live A at 1.62 survives jumps to `[B 0.9]` and to `[]`; seeded-only A jumping to `[B 0.9, A 3]` gives 0.9.
- *a second jump still borrows from the pair measured live before the first* is new: 1.677 after both jumps.
- :135 is renamed to *a jump to a branch with no reply, before any live sample, leaves nothing to borrow*, still k 1.

With 4066711's `calibration.ts` restored under these tests, 2 fail (the two new cases) and 23 pass. With 6216ef9's, all pass.
